jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium portrait mobile tower-defense game cover, no text, no UI. Reference image 1 is the user's original CxQ Growth hero, preserve precisely the brown hair, large brown eyes, leafy green hood with sprout, cream tunic, brown boots, staff and satchel. Reference image 2 is the established acorn crossbow troop, preserve its distinct design. Compose these recognizable characters as allies guarding a luminous mint dream crystal in an ornate little pedestal on a woodland stone terrace. Growth hero center, acorn defender at the side, small distant dark whimsical monster silhouettes approaching along a path. Rich handcrafted storybook toy/clay rendering matching both references. Hero scene concentrated in middle 30%-70%; peaceful sky and forest canopy top 22% reserved for title overlay, clear bottom 25% terrace for separate buttons. Cohesive teal, forest green and warm gold lighting, vivid readable silhouettes, not realistic humans. Full bleed portrait 2:3 composition. This is one complete background illustration, never a contact sheet or sprite atlas. No written words, letters, borders, watermark. Keep reference IP identity exactly.
